title: did-rollup-registry-artifact: event-based vs storage-based DID registries on Ethereum rollups
description: Contracts, measurement scripts, raw measurement data, analysis, figure and table scripts, and the on-chain transaction trail for the paper 'Anchoring Decentralized Identifiers on Ethereum Rollups: A Gas-Level Comparison of Event-Based and Storage-Based Registry Designs' (IEEE INDICON 2026). Code: MIT. The measurement data in the data/ directory: CC-BY-4.0.
notes: AI-use disclosure: The authors used Claude (Anthropic) for language refinement of the manuscript and assistance with the plotting scripts used to prepare Figs. 1-3 in Section V (Results). The authors reviewed the refined text, plotting scripts and resulting figures and take full responsibility for the content of the paper and artifact. Correction (25 October 2026): This disclosure replaces the earlier AI-use statements, which overstated the scope of AI assistance. This correction concerns the AI disclosure only; the research code, data and results are unchanged. The ERC-1056 registry is third-party code.
